abstract: BACKGROUND: Malignant ascites often develops in patients with ovarian cancer, but there is a lack of more detailed characterization of the different histological subtypes. METHODS: Ascites specimens from patients with ovarian cancer who were treated at Bayreuth Hospital from 2006 to 2015, with follow-up until December 2016, were reevaluated retrospectively. RESULTS: A total of 191 women (mean age 64 years, range 48-79) were included, of whom 180 (94.2%) had carcinoma, three (1.6%) had malignant mixed müllerian tumors (MMMTs), four (2.1%) had sex cord-stromal tumors (SCSTs), three (1.6%) had germ cell tumors (GCTs), and one (0.5%) had a sarcoma. The carcinoma group comprised 134 (70.1%) patients with high-grade serous papillary ovarian cancer, 17 (8.9%) with low-grade serous papillary ovarian cancer, 10 (5.3%) with mucinous carcinomas, nine (4.7%) with endometrioid carcinomas, six (3.1%) with clear cell carcinomas, and four (2.1%) with neuroendocrine tumors. The latter group consisted of two patients with mixed neuroendocrine-nonneuroendocrine tumors (MiNENs), one with only a small cell carcinoma (SCCO), and one with a mucinous carcinoid. The noncarcinomatous group of eight patients (4.2%) included three (1.6%) with Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor and mature cystic teratoma (MCT), one (0.5%) with a granulosa cell tumor, and one with a leiomyosarcoma. A statistically significant difference in the proportion of patients with malignant ascites was observed, at 17.7% (3/17) in those with low-grade serous papillary ovarian cancer and 91.8% (123/134) in those with high-grade serous papillary ovarian carcinomas. In both patients with MiNEN, the glandular tumor cell component was found in the ascites. Tumor cells were found in the ascitic fluid in 50% (5/10) of patients with mucinous ovarian carcinomas, 16.7% (1/6) of those with clear cell carcinomas, and 33.3% (1/3) of those with MMMTs. The two patients (2/3; 66.7%) with neoplastic squamous cell components in MCT and the only patient with a granulosa cell tumor in the SCST group (1/4; 25%) had malignant cell populations in the ascites, whereas patients with endometrioid cell carcinoma and leiomyosarcoma lacked tumor cells in the ascites. The malignant ascites was detected at the initial diagnosis in all 138 (100%) patients with ovarian neoplasms. CONCLUSIONS: High-grade serous papillary ovarian cancer was the main histological subtype most frequently found in ascites fluid in this series. The significant difference (P < 0.00001) in the malignancy rate in comparison with low-grade serous papillary carcinoma confirms the histological distinction between the two entities. Initial evidence of ovarian cancer in ascites fluid allows correct primary diagnosis in cytology specimens and is important for staging and prognosis.
abstract_ja: 背景：悪性腹水は卵巣がん患者にしばしば生じるが、組織学的亜型ごとの詳細な特徴づけは不足している。方法：2006年から2015年までバイロイト病院で治療を受けた卵巣がん患者の腹水検体を、2016年12月までの追跡調査と併せて後方視的に再評価した。結果：合計191例の女性（平均年齢64歳、範囲48～79歳）が対象となり、そのうち180例（94.2%）が癌腫、3例（1.6%）が悪性混合ミュラー腫瘍（MMMT）、4例（2.1%）が性索間質性腫瘍（SCST）、3例（1.6%）が胚細胞腫瘍（GCT）、1例（0.5%）が肉腫であった。癌腫群は、高異型度漿液性乳頭状卵巣がん134例（70.1%）、低異型度漿液性乳頭状卵巣がん17例（8.9%）、粘液性癌10例（5.3%）、類内膜癌9例（4.7%）、明細胞癌6例（3.1%）、神経内分泌腫瘍4例（2.1%）から構成された。後者の群は、混合神経内分泌－非神経内分泌腫瘍（MiNEN）の2例、小細胞癌（SCCO）のみの1例、粘液性カルチノイドの1例からなった。非癌腫群の8例（4.2%）は、セルトリ・ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（MCT）の3例（1.6%）、顆粒膜細胞腫瘍の1例（0.5%）、平滑筋肉腫の1例からなった。悪性腹水の割合には統計学的に有意な差が認められ、低異型度漿液性乳頭状卵巣がんでは17.7%（3/17）、高異型度漿液性乳頭状卵巣がんでは91.8%（123/134）であった。MiNENの2例ではいずれも腺性腫瘍細胞成分が腹水中に認められた。粘液性卵巣癌の10例中5例（50%）、明細胞癌の6例中1例（16.7%）、MMMTの3例中1例（33.3%）で腹水中に腫瘍細胞が認められた。MCTにおける扁平上皮細胞成分の腫瘍性病変を有する2例（2/3；66.7%）と、SCST群の顆粒膜細胞腫瘍の唯一の症例（1/4；25%）は、腹水中に悪性細胞集団を有していた。一方、類内膜癌および平滑筋肉腫の患者では腹水に腫瘍細胞は認められなかった。悪性腹水は、卵巣腫瘍を有する138例（100%）全例で初診時に検出された。結論：高異型度漿液性乳頭状卵巣がんは、本研究で腹水中に最も頻繁に認められた主要な組織学的亜型であった。低異型度漿液性乳頭状癌と比較した悪性度の割合の有意差（P < 0.00001）は、両者の組織学的区別を裏付けるものである。腹水中の卵巣がんの初期所見は細胞診検体での正確な原発巣診断を可能にし、病期分類と予後にとって重要である。
